title: "Java Full Stack Developer"
description:
Java Full Stack Developer
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)
Duration: Long Term

W2 Role Only

Required: Azure, React.js, Angular, Micro services
Need 10 to 15 years of experience candidates with Finance/ Banking experience.

Required Skills and Experience

Backend Technologies: Proficiency in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and Restful API development. Frontend Technologies: Strong experience with React.js, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript. Micro services Architecture: Hands-on experience designing and implementing scalable microservices. Cloud Computing: Working knowledge of Azure Cloud (App Services, Azure DevOps, etc.). Database: Experience with relational (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases. CI/CD: Familiarity with tools like Jenkins, Git, or Azure DevOps for automated builds and deployments. Version Control: Proficiency with Git or similar version control systems. Agile Methodologies: Understanding of Scrum or Kanban processes.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes. Knowledge of secure coding practices and application security. Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana). Familiarity with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka).
